summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K to announce a poster presentation at the ALS Nexus 2026 conference. The poster covers the Phase 2a BANYAN trial of intranasal foralumab in ALS, including preclinical data, study design, and the Healey ALS MyMatch protocol. The trial is a 3:1 randomized, placebo-controlled multicenter study in operational start-up. This is a routine clinical development communication, not a special situation. No deal terms or corporate actions are involved.
